title: Older looking Kiln
description: Retextures the Kiln made by claybaughjax to make it look older-ish
body: This resource pack just retextures the Kiln block from the Kiln Furnace mod made by claybaughjax to make it look older-ish I guess, Just a fun little project I made so that the block can fit with the rest of the blocks in my programmer art pack.
